`Love Matters' is a series of half-hour stand-alone comedies that - surprise! - paint a picture of romance in the 21st century. From one-night stands to unrequited love, internet dating to long-term relationships, and arranged marriages to dates with fate, the heartaches and heart-pounding joy of love are exposed in comical fashion by some of the top writers and actors in the business. Katherine Parkinson, Sarah Solemani, Rebekah Staton, Lucien Laviscount, Poppy Rush, Alex Carter, Brett Goldstein and Daniel Lawrence Taylor are among the featured stars.
